entities.summary: Achaemenid Persian, a notable figure in the history of Azerbaijan, associated with Caucasian Albania and Ancient Azerbaijani Lands (550 BCE–150 BCE). Preceded by Zoroastrian fire temples flourish at sites like Ateshgah and Mannaea and Early Cultures. Their legacy influenced Atropates establishes Media Atropatene as an independent kingdom.
